title: Coordinate file-backed stores across processes
description: Deep-dive audit 2026-08-08 verified that FileMemoryStore and FileEventStore use instance-local locks, while FileVarStore shares a fixed temporary path without a writer lock. Singleton registration only coordinates one process. Concurrent app/service processes can race on memory saves, event appends, and variable updates. Evidence: MemorySmith.Storage/FileMemoryStore.cs, FileEventStore.cs, FileVarStore.cs, MemorySmith.App/Hosting/MemorySmithStorageSetup.cs. Add OS-level coordination or explicitly prevent multi-process use, with two-process tests.
